headline: EU Coordinates with IEA on Potential G7 Strategic Oil Releases
summary: The European Commission is coordinating with the International Energy Agency regarding potential G7 emergency crude stock releases aimed at mitigating high global energy prices.
why: Strategic petroleum reserve releases alter global crude supply balances and manage short-term price spikes.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Prospects of coordinated G7 strategic stockpile releases exert downward pressure on spot crude prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Announcements of potential strategic reserve releases reduced energy supply bottleneck concerns.
